  Description: "Known as the Tower of the Guard, the mighty walled city of Minas Tirith is the bulwark that has kept the endless legions of the Red Eye at bay through the long and gruelling centuries. Mighty though her ramparts are, the defenders of the White City cannot stand idle behind their fortifications and hope for victory. Instead, at the Steward's orders, warbands and patrols must constantly venture forth, hunting down the spies of Mordor and guarding key locations such as river-crossings and vantage points.\n\nFor the warriors of Minas Tirith selected for such duties, great risk and thrilling adventure beckon – success will see promotion, glory and riches, for nothing in the land of Gondor is valued more than the courage and strength required to keep its lands safe."

carrying nothing: matches warrior no hero no | choices warrior:  | hero: 
carrying Bow: matches warrior yes hero yes | choices warrior: promo:1:0=Citadel Guard with Longbow | hero: promo:1:0=Citadel Guard with Longbow
    to Citadel Guard (given Longbow): warrior keeps [] drops [Bow]; a hero keeps everything
carrying Shield: matches warrior no hero no | choices warrior: promo:0:0=Knight of Minas Tirith | hero: promo:0:0=Knight of Minas Tirith
carrying Spear: matches warrior no hero no | choices warrior: promo:0:0=Knight of Minas Tirith | hero: promo:0:0=Knight of Minas Tirith
carrying everything: matches warrior yes hero yes | choices warrior: promo:0:0=Knight of Minas Tirith, promo:1:0=Citadel Guard with Longbow | hero: promo:0:0=Knight of Minas Tirith, promo:1:0=Citadel Guard with Longbow
    to Citadel Guard (given Longbow): warrior keeps [Spear] drops [Bow, Shield]; a hero keeps everything
